title: AI News Daily — August 16, 2026
summary: SpaceX closed its $60 billion all-stock purchase of Cursor — the largest startup acquisition on record — folding the coding tool into Musk's GPU empire. Meanwhile, a fourth plaintiff joined a lawsuit accusing xAI's Grok of generating child sexual abuse material from a real photo. And Google halved Gemini 3.7 Flash's price while sharply lifting its coding and agent benchmarks.
